limitations: Host-dependent phenotype; clinical isolates have other resistance determinants.

The expression-assay result does not establish isolate-level resistance from sequence alone.

references.identity_link: The 2020 primary Table1 identifies HON10 Cfr(C) as 100% protein-identical to CCL89685; Results/Methods identify HON10 as the assayed enzyme source. CCL89685.1 is BN189_4390007 in T10; CANB01000378.1 CDS3774..5024 translation equals FASTA and GenPept ORIGIN.
references.assay_endpoint: In vitro rRNA methylation and HPLC identification of C8-methyladenosine
limitations: Assayed protein was produced from a codon-optimized construct; natural reference amino acids are used here, not a construct sequence.
Exact identity linkage relies on the published 100% identity statement, not independent sequencing of the assay construct.
In vitro RNA-fragment methylation does not by itself establish native-host phenotype or clinical resistance.

references.source_review_status: Official archived sequence; functional evidence audited separately from source annotation.
references.evidence_notes: OG1RF rlmN deletion removes measured m2A from 23S rRNA and tRNA. This supports an alternative RNA-methylation role, not a universal non-AMR or safety label.
references.identity_link: AEA94342.1 explicitly names strain OG1RF and locus OG1RF_11655. Its 357 residues equal UniProt A0ACD6TD29 and map to RefSeq WP_002356987.1. Three published targeted-proteomics peptides match; paper coordinates are one less than 1-based positions (documented in audit).
references.assay_endpoint: Native-gene deletion with RNA nucleoside LC-MS/MS; not an isolated-enzyme or de novo site-specific mapping assay.

panels.interpretation_scope: Relationship to an expanded source-audited natural Cfr/RlmN reference panel; not a functional probability or isolate phenotype.
interpretation_notes: RlmN is a competing methyltransferase family, not a universal non-resistance control.
C2 chemistry is inferred for the Brevibacillus and Newman RlmN comparators, although gene-linked rRNA modification was tested.
The panel is a bounded research pilot and does not represent all sequence diversity or all possible functions.
Source review checks identity and published evidence; no independent expert review or held-out classification validation is asserted.
No phylogenetic root or outgroup is asserted.
v2 adds three exact-sequence-linked natural comparators: Cfr(B) AKV84429.1, Cfr(C) CCL89685.1 and OG1RF RlmN AEA94342.1.
Original v1 reference entries, including context-only Bacillus subtilis O34617, are unchanged.
Evidence differs by reference: gene-linked phenotype, direct biochemical chemistry, or native-gene deletion with RNA modification assays.
The new records were inspected during development and cannot serve as untouched independent validation cases.
Reference expansion does not revise the homogeneous_clade_interior_v1 scoring rule or its thresholds.
